minimal.human_labeling_plan: Label the TOP_100 audit queue first; one rater, one pass, 6-way answer space; no production training.
minimal.model_complexity: L2 logistic regression on handcrafted pair-level covariates (bpm/cs/ar/od/duration/object_count/slider_ratio/n_slider_rows/segment_index/time).
minimal.notes: Smallest budget. Use only frozen computational proxies for audit; do not fit high-variance models.

realistic.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_100 plus 10% random fill-in pairs; record CANNOT_JUDGE reasons verbatim.
realistic.model_complexity: Calibrated logistic regression (sigmoid temperature scaling) with 5-fold cross-validation.
realistic.notes: Calibration is more valuable than capacity at this label volume.

recommended.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_100 only; annotate each pair with a forced-choice plus a CANNOT_JUDGE reason. Reserve ~5% for blind duplicate QA.
recommended.model_complexity: Same calibrated logistic regression; report learning curve and bootstrap CIs.
recommended.notes: Do not expand beyond the audited construct yet.

surrogate_auc_reference.caveat: surrogate logistic-regression AUC from the offline active-learning sim; NOT human accuracy

minimal.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_300; include P1/P2/P4/P7 classes to cover separated, reversed and near-boundary pairs.
minimal.model_complexity: Logistic regression with per-feature standardisation and weak-supervision status as an auxiliary feature.
minimal.notes: Keep model small enough to inspect weights.

realistic.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_300 then add 20 random/diversity pairs for calibration coverage.
realistic.model_complexity: Logistic regression or GBM with shallow depth (<=3) and 3-fold CV; evaluate on held-out split.
realistic.notes: Shallow GBM can capture simple interactions without overfitting at this size.

recommended.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_300; one rater with second-rater spot-check on 10% of pairs; record per-pair difficulty confidence.
recommended.model_complexity: Shallow gradient boosting (depth<=3, lr=0.05, early stopping on validation) plus temperature-scaled logistic regression.
recommended.notes: Use the AL sim U+D curve as a relative efficiency reference only.

surrogate_auc_reference.caveat: surrogate logistic-regression AUC from the offline active-learning sim; NOT human accuracy

minimal.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_500; one rater full pass plus 10% duplicate QA.
minimal.model_complexity: Shallow GBM (depth<=3) or logistic regression with interaction terms.
minimal.notes: Minimum viable human sample for reliable calibration of decision boundary.

realistic.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_500 plus random sample from underrepresented splits (val/test) and sparse-slider regions.
realistic.model_complexity: GBM with depth<=3 and 5-fold grouped CV (group by set_group_key).
realistic.notes: Grouped CV prevents mapper/set leakage and gives honest CIs.

recommended.human_labeling_plan: Two raters on TOP_500; adjudicate disagreements; hold out 10% for inter-rater reliability (Cohen's kappa).
recommended.model_complexity: Same grouped GBM + calibrated logistic regression; report feature importances against the construct definitions.
recommended.notes: Two raters become worthwhile at this budget.

surrogate_auc_reference.caveat: surrogate logistic-regression AUC from the offline active-learning sim; NOT human accuracy

minimal.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_1000 (all high-information classes) with one rater and 15% duplicate QA.
minimal.model_complexity: GBM depth<=4 with grouped CV; no deep models.
minimal.notes: The AL sim PATH full-pool logistic AUC is about 0.759; do not extrapolate to human accuracy.

realistic.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_1000 then add 50 random pairs per split; two raters on 20%.
realistic.model_complexity: GBM depth<=4 or Bayesian logistic regression; grouped CV; temperature calibration.
realistic.notes: At this size, label noise from ambiguous pairs starts to matter; track CANNOT_JUDGE rate.

recommended.human_labeling_plan: Two raters on TOP_1000, adjudicate; active-learning pass (uncertainty+diversity) for the next batch.
recommended.model_complexity: Ensemble of shallow GBM + calibrated logistic regression; no deep learning yet.
recommended.notes: Use simulated efficiency only as a weak prior; human labels may disagree with the surrogate oracle.

surrogate_auc_reference.caveat: surrogate logistic-regression AUC from the offline active-learning sim; NOT human accuracy

minimal.human_labeling_plan: Label TOP_1000 core set plus 1000 active-learning selected pairs; one rater with 20% duplicate QA.
minimal.model_complexity: GBM/random forest with grouped CV and calibration.
minimal.notes: Larger budgets are justified only if human disagreement rate is high.

realistic.human_labeling_plan: Two-rater pipeline; label TOP_1000 plus 1000 uncertainty/diversity pairs; adjudicate disagreements.
realistic.model_complexity: GBM + shallow MLP (1 hidden layer) or Bayesian models with grouped CV; model selection by held-out log-loss.
realistic.notes: Human capacity, not model capacity, is the bottleneck.

recommended.human_labeling_plan: Two raters, adjudication; label TOP_1000 plus 1000 active-learning pairs; report inter-rater kappa and CANNOT_JUDGE rate; still no final production model training.
recommended.model_complexity: Stacked ensemble (shallow GBM, MLP, logistic regression) with grouped CV, temperature calibration, and bootstrap uncertainty.
recommended.notes: Use this budget only if the audit discovers systematic human-proxy divergence; otherwise 1000 labels suffice for the audit.

surrogate_auc_reference.caveat: surrogate logistic-regression AUC from the offline active-learning sim; NOT human accuracy

cross_cutting_notes.label_safety: Do not expose target-metric values to participants; do not train final production models during this audit.
cross_cutting_notes.simulated_efficiency_finding: In the surrogate simulation, random acquisition was competitive with active strategies for the PATH task; uncertainty was no better than random for TIME. Intelligent sampling did not substantially reduce required labels in this already-curated candidate pool.
